name: agentforge
description: AI Agent Enhancement Platform - Modular skills for AI agents

interface.shortDescription: AI Agent skills: OCR, Translate, Vision, Desktop, GitHub, Dev Tools
interface.longDescription:
AgentForge is a modular platform with 6 pluggable skills:
- OCR: Text recognition from images
- Translate: Multi-language translation
- Vision: Image analysis and screen understanding
- Desktop: Window capture and automation
- GitHub: Repository analysis and documentation
- Dev Toolkit: JSON, Base64, JWT, UUID, Hash, Regex
